name: Kagami Aoi
source:
A retired and well-known player. She watches over the other club members with severe affection. Counselor of the Kunahama FC club. Her apparent "cool" attitude is exactly why others hold her in high regard. A person Masaya can't handle very well, but also someone who is close to him from way before his enrollment at the academy.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
translation:
退役的知名选手。她带着严厉的关爱照看其他社团成员，是库纳哈马FC部的顾问。她表面上的“冷酷”正是别人敬重她的原因。她是雅也难以应付的人，却早在他入学前就与他关系亲近。

[来源：[url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
